pages.text: The Slimic resembles a weathered Overworld under a layer of gel. Damp Plains covers its hills, lowlands, caves, and waterways. Green stone, wet soil, silt, and scattered gel patches form its landscape.

Wild Slimes roam the surface. Frogs inhabit the plains and bats live underground; familiar hostile mobs can appear in the dark. The dimension follows the ordinary day and night cycle, and beds can set a respawn point.

Bring tools, food, building supplies, and a way to mark your portal. Surface gel can bounce and slow travel. Companions can work here with their normal equipment and supplies. They arrive through a slime portal in Wait; issue a new command when ready.
